description: This file provides a wrapper around GLib functions, including factory methods for creating GLib wrapper instances, and utility functions for GLib object manipulation and string operations. It also manages singleton instances of wrappers and logs errors during creation failures.

classes.name: GlibWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class providing static methods for GLib object and string operations.

classes.name: GlibWrapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing singleton instances of IGlibWrapper and IGlibWrapperFactory.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton factory instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getGlibWrapper
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton GLib wrapper instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: gObjectSet
methods.description: Sets properties on a GObject using variable arguments.

methods.name: gObjectGet
methods.description: Gets properties from a GObject using variable arguments.

methods.name: gObjectClassFindProperty
methods.description: Finds a property in a GObject class by name.

methods.name: gStrdupPrintf
methods.description: Creates a formatted string using printf-style arguments.

methods.name: gStrHasPrefix
methods.description: Checks if a string has a specified prefix.
